body:
# FAST DATAPACK MAYBE BUGY!


- U can use any block as hat on ur Copper Golems!
- Hold Block on ur offhand and hit Copper Golem with Copper Nugget
- Remove hat, hit Copper Golem with Copper Nugget with clear offhand
- Only consumes nugget and keeps block
